```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(recount3)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
```

## Download data

Download the RangedSummarizedExperiment (RSE) for SRP150473 from recount3,
caching locally to avoid re-downloading on each render.

```{r}
#| label: download-rse
rse_file <- here::here("analysis", "SRP150473_rse.rds")

if (file.exists(rse_file)) {
  rse <- readRDS(rse_file)
} else {
  human_projects <- available_projects()
  project_info <- subset(
    human_projects,
    project == "SRP150473" & project_type == "data_sources/sra"
  )
  rse <- create_rse(project_info)
  saveRDS(rse, rse_file)
}
```

## Explore the RSE

```{r}
#| label: rse-dimensions
dim(rse)
```

The RSE has `r nrow(rse)` genes and `r ncol(rse)` samples.

### Sample metadata

```{r}
#| label: col-data-table
col_df <- as.data.frame(colData(rse))
DT::datatable(col_df, row.names = FALSE, options = list(scrollX = TRUE))
```

### Metadata summary

```{r}
#| label: metadata-summary
col_df |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_unique_biosample = n_distinct(sra.sample_acc),
    instrument = paste(unique(sra.instrument), collapse = ", "),
    library_layout = paste(unique(sra.library_layout), collapse = ", ")
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Basic QC: Total counts per sample

```{r}
#| label: qc-total-counts
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
total_counts <- colSums(assay(rse, "raw_counts"))

qc_df <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(rse),
  total_counts = total_counts
)

ggplot(qc_df, aes(x = reorder(sample, total_counts), y = total_counts)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Sample", y = "Total counts", title = "Total counts per sample") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))
```
